selection_reason: HALO was preregistered as the adjacent mechanism before any TXG qualification outcome, joins the price surface to a dynamic named-partner economic relation, and does not rely on the below-threshold short-volume lane. It is not selected by stepping down a ranked list after failure.
economic_mechanism: HALO supplies drug-delivery technology while partners fund development and commercialization.
